label: prop:color-elliptic
title: Color fibre as an elliptic curve
html:
Let z=x_0/x_1\in\mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}) be the projective spacetime ratio (braid group action(i)). We substitute the constraint x_0+x_1=C and eliminate x_0,x_1 in favour of z. The quadratic and cubic power-sum conditions on the color variable X=(x_2,x_3,x_4) reduce at each fixed z to the cubic

X^3+(z+1)X^2+(z^2+z+1)X+(z^3+z^2+z+1)=0.

The variable X is so named because the geometry of the fibre is a weave of colorful twisted tubes with fractal boundary structure, capturing color, chirality, and rigidity. For generic z, this cubic defines an elliptic curve \mathcal{E}_z in the color fibre. Its j-invariant varies as a rational function of z. The monodromy of \mathcal{E}_z around the singular fibres (where the discriminant of the cubic vanishes) recovers the holonomy generators H_1,H_2 of holonomy of trefoil.
